ownership.markovian: per-investigator chunk loop and stop handling; official reference engine
ownership.hmem: per-case memory of code-generated observation digests, recalled for open questions
ownership.world_model: shared case graph across specialist investigators (accounts, transactions, cited findings); official reference engine
ownership.zetaris: all transaction access, day-sharded feature store, multi-hop tracing, population metrics
ownership.project_adapter: contracts, budgets, permissions, evidence completeness, label isolation, rule learner

tier_agent.status: LLM tiering and priority policy over layer-1 alerts, compiled to SQL and applied in Zetaris; gated against the tier model

adjudication.status: senior investigator's risk level and report decision on the team's finished case file

investigator_training.status: in-context: reference cases, tool effectiveness and per-tier verdict standards from a labelled development round

risk_tiers.status: layer 2: gradient-boosted trees over layer-1 alerts, compiled to SQL and scored in Zetaris

rule_learning.learner: scikit-learn DecisionTreeClassifier; thresholds fitted on development labels only
rule_learning.development_training_sample: every positive development window plus a deterministic hash sample of negatives, read per day shard
rule_learning.objective: layer 1 is high recall: share of in-scope laundering chains with any member account alerted on any day
rule_learning.monitor_rollback: monitor chain recall below the target while the parent meets it, or more than 0.02 below the parent's
rule_learning.investigation: every case runs as a team: coordinator, parallel specialists, World Model aggregator
